:::{#cor-double-well-basin-bound}
#### Basins of the double-well function are bounded

Let $f(x) = x^4 - 2x^2$,
and run [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent)
with a fixed [step length](#def-gradient-descent) $\steplen > 0$.
Every start $\iterpoint{x}{0}$ in the [basin of attraction](#def-basin-of-attraction)
of a [local minimizer](algebra-basics.qmd#def-local-minimizer) of $f$ satisfies

$$
\iterpoint{x}{0}^2 \le 1 + \frac{1}{2\steplen}.
$$

:::

::: proof

The [iterates](#def-iterate) from a start in the basin
[converge](#def-vector-sequence-limit) to a local minimizer,
so they do not diverge to $\infty$.
By @prp-double-well-divergence, the start therefore does not satisfy
$\iterpoint{x}{0}^2 > 1 + 1 / (2\steplen)$.

:::
